prompt:
Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density.
Match the palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle of the attached reference sprites exactly.
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: matsushimaya-v1.png. Snap this same storefront to a clean consistent pixel grid for 96x80 runtime export. Keep its gray tile roof, red/cream scalloped striped awning, white noren, left sweets display, left plant and right doorway in identical positions and proportions. No text or logos; retain decorative red abstract motifs. Change only pixel grid consistency and simplify microtexture into crisp clusters. Preserve the silhouette, layout, viewing angle and palette. Hard transparent exterior, no glow or floor. Do not redesign the shop.
notes: Anchors are zero-based runtime pixel coordinates from top-left. Door marks the threshold; foot marks the bottom-center sorting point. Collision rectangle is centered above foot, in 16px ground tiles; roof overhang and transparent padding are not collision. Map owner must place a walkable portal immediately in front of the door. Art reviewed at 1x and 4x; approval covers sprite export, not in-game map integration.
